job.backgroundReason: Importer writes opaque #101014 when the scene is accepted. Reference frames are composited on the same colour.
job.observation: One composition cycle from ip 0 to op 24 at 25 fps. The file is not an infinite timeline; loop is a player behaviour. Near-end is 99.5% of the way from ip to op so the out-point does not blank the frame. No interactive input is encoded in the JSON.
